network_status.summary_it: Quasi tutti gli idrometri furono sormontati, danneggiati o asportati; Bettolelle fu l’unica eccezione indicata dal rapporto.
network_status.summary_en: Nearly all gauges were overtopped, damaged or swept away; Bettolelle was the only exception identified by the report.

sources.title: Rapporto di evento: maltempo 15, 16 e 17 settembre 2022

curation_note.it: Il rapporto documenta il collasso della rete di misura nel bacino, non una serie completa alla sezione del ponte sul Misa. Nessun colmo, livello o idrogramma viene assegnato al manufatto.
curation_note.en: The report documents monitoring-network failure in the basin, not a complete series at the Misa bridge section. No peak, stage or hydrograph is assigned to the asset.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official regional event report

caveats: The monitoring-network failure is documented at basin scale and is not a bridge-section observation.
No observed flood peak can be assigned to the event point from the incomplete gauge record.
The surviving Bettolelle gauge is downstream of the Misa-Nevola confluence and is not substituted for the event section.
Basin processes provide event context and do not by themselves prove the bridge-collapse mechanism.
